_comment: 'X+1' was a bare string amount, which resolves to 0, so this looked at nothing and found nothing. The REVEAL_CARD_COST_GTE cost and the trailing REVEAL/PUT_CARDS_BOTTOM were invented -- the text has no such cost, and 'then shuffle' is what SEARCH_DECK already does. The traps are chosen from the cards LOOKED AT, not from the whole deck, so the search is scoped to that ref.
